model: coated noncoplanar microstrip, top signal L1 referenced L2; mirrored bottom L4 referenced L3
warnings: API nominal model calculation is not fabricated impedance measurement. Request real impedance control and fabricator confirmation/coupon before manufacture.
Live calculator configurations differ from static help article: taper0.5mil vs0.7mil, maskC1/C3 1.0mil vs1.2mil, coreDk4.42 vsstatic4.6. Exact saved API inputs govern these results.
0.035mm copper is nominal drawing; finished solver copper0.04064mm is distinct. Do not alter dielectric thickness just to force exact1.600mm total.
Noncoplanar solver requires surrounding surface copper sufficiently distant; nearby pours need coplanar calculation or spacing verification.
KiCad class width/gap defaults alone do not enforce fabricated impedance; optional custom geometry/skew rules and continuous reference planes are needed.

CSI/ETH nominal width0.150mm/gap0.500mm yields99.7274ohm differential; independent50ohm width0.160mm yields49.5236ohm. Differential odd mode is Zdiff/2; isolated single-line impedance is a distinct calculation.

The wider100ohm pair is0.800mm wide overall. CM5/FFC pad escapes can need short local spacing/width transitions; inspect their reference plane and transition lengths rather than claim constant impedance through the footprints.

Noncoplanar calculation includes no neighboring surface ground/copper. Widening pair gap weakens mutual coupling; nearby other nets/pours can then disturb the model. Verify spacing to neighboring copper or use the coplanar solver before fabrication.

KiCad10 Physical Stackup dialog OK sets general board thickness to the sum. General nominal1.6 and exact vendor dielectric/copper are independently parseable, but accepting that dialog can change general thickness.

Omitting soldermask thickness uses KiCad default0.010mm per side. This is an assumed mechanical display value; KiCad cannot represent all nonuniform C1/C2/C3 coating dimensions in one layer. JLC saved solver inputs remain authoritative for the impedance result.

rules.requirement_scope: Each P/N pair independently; no matching of all camera lanes to one another.

limitations: JLC calculator values are nominal model outputs, not fabricated impedance measurements. Specify controlled impedance and confirm the final stackup with JLC when ordering.
Signal geometry applies to coated outer-layer microstrip over continuous GND. Do not route over plane gaps.
Nearby unrelated surface copper is excluded from the solver; keep it at least 0.5 mm away outside connector escapes, or recalculate using a coplanar model.
Connector and via escapes require review; pair gap/width may need short local transitions. The main routing width is 0.15 mm, and the 0.10 mm global minimum is for reviewed local escapes.
Nominal drawing outer copper 0.035 mm is distinct from plated copper 0.04064 mm used by the live JLC solver. CAD mask thickness is the solver over-trace model, not a manufacturing measurement.
Power netclass widths are routing starting values. They do not establish ampacity, voltage drop, or thermal performance.
SE_50R is reserved for selected future single-ended signals. Its separate 0.16 mm geometry does not apply to the CSI pairs.
Ground planes are the layer plan; this change does not create or fill PCB zones.

fabricationRules.process: 4-layer FR4, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner, ENIG, standard green soldermask, conventional through vias
fabricationRules.fixedPadException: Two Pads with the same actual Parent UUID; all routing and other-footprint copper retain the impedance spacing policy. SMD land spacing still >=0.15 mm.
limitations: 0.10 track/space and 0.50 copper/edge are chosen margins above current JLC multilayer absolute capabilities.
The 0.10 mm soldermask-web assumption requires green/red/yellow/blue/purple 1 oz; black/white require revisiting the web at >=0.13 mm.
Existing footprint/pad soldermask overrides remain; narrow or merged openings still require assembly review.
NPTH milled slots >=1.0 mm and plated milled slots >=0.35 mm with length>=2xwidth require final drill/route-file inspection.
No micro/blind/buried vias enabled. No placement-dependent escape exceptions were created.
PCB synchronization, duplicate-reference removal, routing and final DFM remain required.
